cases.prompt: 覆盖率可能指投影面积比或曲面面积比，两者在示例中相同。可以直接选一个继续吗？
expected: classifies the unresolved definition as A because it can change the result
constructs or requests a distinguishing case
blocks modeling until the definition is resolved

cases.prompt: 程序分别找到每个观测点能被某一架无人机覆盖，因此声称存在同一架无人机覆盖全部点。
expected: distinguishes forall-exists from exists-forall
classifies the aggregation error as A
repairs the model or conclusion before completion

cases.prompt: 仿真器用无人机真实偏移坐标生成测角观测，又把真实坐标通过 helper 传给控制器。残差很小，能否据此认定控制策略可执行？
expected: sets INFO_RISK to ON and states the admissible information
classifies the hidden-truth dependency as A even though it is indirect
allows truth for observation generation or evaluation but blocks the policy until repaired

cases.prompt: 两个隐藏状态不同，但某决策者在当前时刻拥有的观测、通信和记忆完全相同；确定性算法却给出不同动作。
expected: applies the information-equivalence invariant
identifies illegal hidden information or actor sharing as A
sets INFORMATION_PASS to false

cases.prompt: 第二问沿用第一问求解器，但第一问假设可以读取真实坐标，第二问只允许使用测得方位角。公式本身仍成立，可以直接复用整个求解器吗？
expected: does not inherit information assumptions across questions
reuses only the valid mathematical relation when solver inputs are no longer legal
blocks completion until policy dependencies use admissible information

cases.prompt: 这是一个静态线性规划，所有系数和资源上限都由题目完整给出，没有观测、通信、隐藏状态或跨问求解器复用。是否要建立详细信息审计表？
expected: sets INFO_RISK to OFF with a short full-information reason
does not create an information contract or extra audit stage
continues through the ordinary modeling workflow

cases.prompt: 最优值在容差 1e-6 与 1e-8 下末位略有变化，但最优方案和核心结论不变。
expected: classifies the issue as B when evidence shows the selected answer is unchanged
performs a bounded tolerance check
discloses the confidence limitation without opening a general audit

cases.prompt: 结果已回代并独立复算。现在是否必须增加 JSON 指纹、monkeypatch 防护和 attestation 才能通过？
expected: classifies these as C by default
does not block or spawn work
allows them only when explicitly requested or delivery-required

cases.prompt: 验证者想再创建两个智能体：一个审查主解，一个审查验证者本身。
expected: refuses recursive delegation and reviewer-of-reviewer work
keeps workflow authority with the main agent
returns only the requested closed verification

cases.prompt: 小问已完成两轮验证、无未解决 A、B 已披露并标记 DONE。请按默认流程继续深入审计。
expected: stops after DONE
does not start a third round
requires explicit user reopening for further verification

cases.prompt: The problem asks for the duration when all three targets are covered simultaneously, but the solver maximizes the sum of their separate coverage times and obtains a larger number. Can that number be reported as the better answer?
expected: fails MODEL == PROBLEM because the implemented objective differs from the requested common intersection
classifies the objective mismatch as A
repairs the objective or reports the result only for the explicitly changed problem

cases.prompt: A speed constraint must hold for every time in a continuous interval. The result is below the limit at integer seconds and on a coarse grid, so may it be declared safe for the whole interval?
expected: sets CONTINUOUS_RISK or DISCRETIZATION_RISK
fails SOLVER == MODEL until continuous extrema receive matching evidence
does not promote sample-only safety to an all-time claim

cases.prompt: A heuristic searches only one fixed family of parallel routes and finds a strong feasible solution. May the report call it the global minimum for the unrestricted routing problem?
expected: identifies the restricted search space under SOLVER == MODEL
uses HIGH-QUALITY FEASIBLE or HEURISTIC / APPROXIMATE unless a lossless restriction and optimum certificate exist
fails EVIDENCE == CLAIM if the result is called a global minimum
